question: In a certain code language, 'ZEBRA' is written as 'YDAQZ'. How will 'HORSE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ZEBRA' is written as 'YDAQZ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3bd1d517e4d788d93afcc3fe1a360946d591c9e9ee1c91ea5b5a45f2e6b749f.png] 

Similarly, for '**HORSE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/129164058965eac4a6ba6b0a7afd7f9f171259cbfeffcdad85ed855050917ccb.png] 

So, 'HORSE' will be written as '**GNQRD**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
